# Wordloop migration fixture

This is test data, never a default workspace. `content/` holds the legacy input, `images/` contains its screenshots, and `provenance/` keeps the import review and the portable supplement (the frozen source documents were removed; see the note in `provenance/REVIEW.md`). Historical citations in the frozen documents retain their original paths.

The runtime export test verifies conversion into repository-owned plans. To try it manually, use the explicit import commands in the root README. Production viewer assets live in `public/`; sample screenshots do not ship with the viewer.
